colourEditSection.headline: A WORLD OF COLOUR, WITH A STORY OF ITS OWN.
colourEditSection.subtitle: Some colours catch your eye. Others stay with you.

families.tagline: A colour with presence. A feeling that stays.
families.description: From midnight oceanic depths to calm cornflower mornings, Ceylon blue sapphires hold light with a quiet, undeniable authority. Untouched by artificial heat, their depth lives in unbroken silence.

families.tagline: Soft at first glance. Impossible to forget.
families.description: Delicate dawn pastels and vibrant lotus blossoms. Pink stones hold the gentle warmth of flushed skin and unspoken affection—radiant, modern, and profoundly intimate.

families.tagline: A meeting of warmth, colour and fascination.
families.description: The rarest natural gem in the world—born only beneath Sri Lankan earth. An ethereal marriage of delicate lotus pink and golden sunrise orange that shifts with the light of every room.

families.tagline: Golden warmth that brings light to skin.
families.description: Like honeyed morning light streaming across linen. Ceylon yellow sapphires glow with an inner fire that brings extraordinary radiance and optimism against bare skin.
Rare Ceylon rubies holding intense natural fluorescence. Under low candlelight, the crimson crystal awakens with an ardent glow that mirrors the unspoken heat of devotion.
Cobalt spinels and twilight-hued violet stones. For the one captivated by the hour when day surrenders to night—unconventional, rare, and deeply poetic.

curationsSection.headline: THINGS WORTH KEEPING CLOSE
curationsSection.subtitle: Discover the creations that speak to you.

items.name: The Royal Solitaire
items.description: Hand-forged platinum holding an unbroken midnight blue Ceylon stone, resting against the skin that remembers you.

items.name: The Lotus Halo
items.description: Rare sunrise padparadscha stone framed by brilliant light, designed to drink the physical warmth of the wearer.

items.name: The Sunset Lotus Collar
items.description: Warm precious metal shaped to rest heavy against her collarbone in private candlelit hours.

items.name: The Three Promises
items.description: Three solitary stones honoring memory, devotion, and the unwritten chapters ahead.

bespokeSection.headline: BEGIN WITH A FEELING.
bespokeSection.lead: Tell us who it is for, what you want them to feel, or the moment you want to remember. Together, we will create something that could belong to no one else.

heartbeatSection.headline: The Heartbeat Gem™: Hidden Against Her Pulse
heartbeatSection.quote: The stone no one else will ever see—resting directly against the pulse point of the one you love.
heartbeatSection.p1: The world sees what you wear on the outside. But the true covenant of your piece remains hidden within.
heartbeatSection.p2: Set flush into the interior curve of the band, a private gemstone rests directly against her skin. Completely invisible to dinner parties, cameras, and strangers—felt with every beat of her pulse.

privateBanner.headline: SOME THINGS BELONG ONLY TO TWO.
privateBanner.description: A glance that says everything. A touch that needs no explanation. A moment the rest of the world never has to understand.

ourHouseSection.headline: A HOUSE BUILT AROUND FEELING.
ourHouseSection.quote: Some things are chosen for how they look. Others are chosen for what they mean.
ourHouseSection.lead: Aviory exists for the latter. For the moments, people and emotions we want to hold close. Every story begins with a feeling, and every personal expression begins with yours.
